blocks.title: Local development and backpressure
blocks.code:
npm ci
npm run build:native
npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
npm run ci
uphill --compact

cards.title: Run freely, untrusted by default
cards.text: Non-maintainers are encouraged to run tests, Uphill audits, and flows. Untrusted runs get read-only cache access and never poison the shared object store.

cards.title: Start with a failing test
cards.text: Reproduce bridge, MCP, plugin, or Chromium issues with the smallest failing test before patching.

cards.title: Keep Lighthouse backpressure green
cards.text: Every change is scored across bridge safety, TypeScript quality, MCP security, fuzzing, and docs.

cards.title: A human maintainer merges
cards.text: Trusted sandbox runs and maintainer review gate protected paths and releases. Agents never approve or merge.

blocks.title: Dub (DangerouslyUseBrowser)
blocks.tagline: A real Chromium 157 fork exposing browser internals directly to agents through native C++20 N-API bindings and an incur MCP server.
blocks.text: Rewrite NetworkService traffic across workers and caches, freeze and step per-tab V8 and Blink clocks, act through native Chromium actor tools and WebMCP, and run QuickJS plugins with one-time sandbox auth.

announcement.label: Built publicly on Smithers Cloud with live Lighthouse backpressure

blocks.title: Connect an agent with one-time sandbox auth
blocks.code:
# Download verified Chromium 157 binary and start authenticated MCP server
dub install
dub serve --port 7777 --print-one-time-token --sandbox-id demo-1

# Connect via MCP HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:7777/mcp
# Or connect your agent to Smithers Cloud MCP: https://smithers.sh/api/mcp

cards.label: DEMO-01
cards.title: Rewrite the network
cards.text: Mock, block, redirect, and patch bodies at NetworkService across tabs, workers, CacheStorage, and HTTP cache.

cards.label: DEMO-02
cards.title: Control the clock
cards.text: Per-tab isolated V8 and Blink engine clock with 31-day jumps, exact frame stepping, and unaffected sibling tabs.

cards.label: DEMO-03
cards.title: Act as you
cards.text: Persistent profile ownership, native Chromium actor tools dispatching trusted events, and live WebMCP page tools.

cards.label: MILESTONE 4
cards.title: QuickJS plugins and triggers
cards.text: Hot-reloadable TypeScript plugins, persistent QuickJS REPL realms, Jev typed evaluators, and reactive event streams.

cards.label: CLOUD AUTH
cards.title: One-time sandbox tokens
cards.text: Single-use SHA-256 bootstrap tokens with timing-safe verification, replay rejection, and untrusted scope attenuation.

cards.label: BACKPRESSURE
cards.title: Lighthouse audit report
cards.text: Uphill scores bridge safety, TypeScript quality, MCP security, fuzzing, and docs on every change.
